input: raw counts with training-only channel mean/std
target: training-only masked target mean/std; invert before scoring
architecture: 176->32 k3 d1 ReLU ->32 k3 d2 ReLU ->32 k3 d4 ReLU ->7 linear
loss: mean squared standardized target error on supplied training masks after burnin
checkpoint: last epoch, fixed in advance; no evaluation-based early stopping
pilot: prior fixed-TCN pilot already established local training cost; no new pilot
augmentation: Independent perchunk/perchannel Bernoulli keep probability0.9, constant across time including burn-in; replace standardized missing channel with0, no inverted scaling; seeded Torch RNG during training only
hypothesis: Exposure to missing standardized channels may reduce reliance on individual observation channels and improve forward-day performance; unstable channels are a hypothesis, not a demonstrated cause

decision.fallback: retain original fixed TCN; no further augmentation search
